name: ALshaya Group

note: Independently confirmed live Kuwaiti baby/kids retailer (self-described 'Kuwaiti brand since 2015', Avenues Mall store) with ~500+ SKUs across clothing/toys/accessories, working cart in KWD; clears scale and repeat-purchase gates.

name: حكاية طفل | Baby Story
note: Verified Jeddah-based toy retailer with multiple physical branches and ~4,500 toys across 100 brands, SAR pricing; approved toy/general-merchandise category, solidly Saudi. The building_materials tag was a keyword error.

name: Fantasy World
note: Live Kuwait toy retailer with multiple stores, extensive multi-category catalog, working KWD cart/checkout and delivery/click-and-collect; approved category and Kuwait-HQ'd. Misfiled building_materials tag.

note: Independent check shows a carpet/flooring/rugs/wallpaper/artificial-turf/parquet-dominant identity with an installation/contracting model (a Gate 3 low-repeat pattern); a furniture/decor line and 70 stores exist but the furniture arm's substantiality relative to the flooring-led core could not be confirmed, so not a clean Yes.

name: Masco Saudi Arabia
note: mascoonline.com is a genuine Jeddah B2C stationery/office-supplies store (individual-consumer pricing, cart, returns policy, multi-category catalog); stationery is an approved repeat-purchase category and the dedicated retail arm stands on its own under the corrected Gate 2.

name: MINISO Saudi Arabia
note: Gate 1 passes: miniso.sa is operated by Alhokair/Cenomi, a Saudi-HQ'd local franchise partner, via a Riyadh operating entity (200-500 staff) with nationwide stores and hundreds of SKUs, not a foreign-parent ccTLD storefront. One caveat: possible Gate 6 consolidation overlap if Cenomi is separately present in the Yes list.

note: Riyadh-based B2C furniture/home-decor retailer with a live SAR e-commerce store (cart, returns), an expanded showroom, and a broad catalog (furniture, tableware, lighting, decor, fragrances); B2B/design is secondary. Approved category, Saudi HQ. Misfiled automotive tag.

name: Nahdi
note: Jeddah-HQ'd Nahdi Medical Company, largest retail pharmacy chain in MENA (1,150+ pharmacies, Tadawul-listed ticker 4164) with a live online pharmacy; retail pharmacy chains are the explicit Gate 2 approved exception. Clear qualifier.

name: Mogahwi Stationery & Office Equipment
note: Almuqahwi Library Co. (est. 1942), Kuwait-HQ'd stationery/office/art-supplies retailer with physical stores and a live Shopify online shop (multiple collections, global brands, checkout); approved repeat-purchase category. Misfiled automotive tag.

note: Kuwait-HQ'd pet-supplies retailer with 2 stores plus a live online store (KWD, multiple payment options), grooming and a mobile app, and a multi-brand catalog; pet supplies is an approved repeat category and the B2B arm is non-disqualifying (Petzone precedent).

name: ORANGE BED & BATH
note: Live Saudi B2C home-textiles store (bedding, bath, plus decor/kitchen/kids) with ~200+ SKUs, SAR pricing, working cart, free-shipping threshold and a Saudi commercial registration/tax number on file; approved home category, broader/higher-repeat than a mattresses-only line. Misfiled building_materials tag.

name: SuperPets_SA
note: Live Salla-hosted Saudi pet-supplies store (cats/dogs/birds; Royal Canin, Hills, Kong, Trixie plus 40+ brands) with SAR checkout; the attached vet clinic is a side service, so pet supplies (approved repeat category) governs. Misfiled healthcare tag.
